title: Multiple Choice (1 point each)
instructions: Select the best answer for each question.

prompts.question: What does normalizing a Vector3 do?
answers: It adjusts the x, y and z values so the magnitude is 1.
It wipes all of the x, y, and z values.
It sets the Y value to 1.
prompts.correct_answer: It adjusts the x, y and z values so the magnitude is 1.

prompts.question: What method is typically used to detect when one object makes physical contact (like a ball hitting a wall)?
Which data type is best for storing true/false values?
Which loop is best for iterating until something happens?
What keyword prevents a variable from being accessible outside of its class?
What is the purpose of a prefab?
What is the main purpose of Invoke()?
answers: Calls a method after a delay
Calls a method on another object
prompts.correct_answer: Calls a method after a delay

prompts.question: Which best describes Input.GetButton vs Input.GetKey?
answers: GetButton uses Input Manager mappings, GetKey checks physical keys
GetButton checks any key, GetKey is spacebar only
prompts.correct_answer: GetButton uses Input Manager mappings, GetKey checks physical keys

prompts.question: Which component must be added for physics movement?
What does overriding a prefab do?
answers: Applies changes from instance to prefab
Resets the instance to match the prefab
prompts.correct_answer: Applies changes from instance to prefab

prompts.question: Which is NOT a Unity data type?
A variable declared inside a method is what kind of variable?
Which statement about methods in C# is true?
answers: A method can call other methods
A method must always return a value
A method cannot accept more than one parameter
A void method cannot contain a return statement
prompts.correct_answer: A method can call other methods
